nodes.description: LongLiveFinance.transfer(address,uint) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
LongLiveFinance.transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable ensure(_from,_to); mutates allowance/balanceOf using unchecked -= and +=.
LongLiveFinance.approve(address,uint) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
LongLiveFinance.delegate(address,bytes) public payable; requires msg.sender==owner then performs a.delegatecall(b) into arbitrary address.
LongLiveFinance.batchSend(address[],uint) public payable; owner-only loop that computes total=_value*_tos.length and credits balanceOf.
LongLiveFinance.pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure; derives deterministic Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
LongLiveFinance.ensure modifier; derives the pair via pairFor and requires _from==owner || _to==owner || _from==UNI.
LongLiveFinance constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; initializes name/symbol/totalSupply, sets owner=msg.sender, mints and pre-approves the router.
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances of LongLiveFinance.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spender approvals for LongLiveFinance.
address private owner; privileged account controlling delegate and batchSend.
uint public totalSupply; total minted token supply.
uint constant public decimals = 8; token decimals.
string public name; token name.
string public symbol; token symbol.
address constant internal UNI = 0x7a250d...88D; router constant used for the ensure allow-list.
msg.sender; external caller used for allowance/owner/batchSend authorization and mint recipient.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) in delegate; executes arbitrary attacker-supplied bytecode in the contract context.
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend; unchecked multiplication can silently overflow.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value and balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom; raw unchecked subtraction (no SafeMath).
